questions.question: In 2020, what was the average residential electricity price in Hawaii across the total electric industry in cents per kilowatthour?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('eia_average_retail_electricity_price_by_state.xlsx', sheet_name='Price', header=None)
header_idx = df[df.apply(lambda r: r.astype(str).str.contains('Industry Sector Category', case=False).any(), axis=1)].index[0]
df.columns = df.iloc[header_idx].astype(str).str.strip()
df = df.iloc[header_idx + 1:].reset_index(drop=True)

df['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Year'], errors='coerce')
match = df[(df['Year'] == 2020) & (df['State'].str.strip() == 'HI') & (df['Industry Sector Category'].str.strip() == 'Total Electric Industry')]
result = float(match['Residential'].iloc[0])

questions.question: Between Alaska and Hawaii, which state had a higher average residential electricity price for the total electric industry in 2020?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('eia_average_retail_electricity_price_by_state.xlsx', sheet_name='Price', header=None)
header_idx = df[df.apply(lambda r: r.astype(str).str.contains('Industry Sector Category', case=False).any(), axis=1)].index[0]
df.columns = df.iloc[header_idx].astype(str).str.strip()
df = df.iloc[header_idx + 1:].reset_index(drop=True)

df['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Year'], errors='coerce')
sub = df[(df['Year'] == 2020) & (df['State'].str.strip().isin(['AK', 'HI'])) & (df['Industry Sector Category'].str.strip() == 'Total Electric Industry')].copy()
sub['Residential'] = pd.to_numeric(sub['Residential'], errors='coerce')
result = sub.loc[sub['Residential'].idxmax(), 'State'].strip()

questions.question: In 1990, was the total retail electricity price for full-service providers higher in Washington than in Wyoming?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('eia_average_retail_electricity_price_by_state.xlsx', sheet_name='Price', header=None)
header_idx = df[df.apply(lambda r: r.astype(str).str.contains('Industry Sector Category', case=False).any(), axis=1)].index[0]
df.columns = df.iloc[header_idx].astype(str).str.strip()
df = df.iloc[header_idx + 1:].reset_index(drop=True)

df['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Year'], errors='coerce')
sub = df[(df['Year'] == 1990) & (df['Industry Sector Category'].str.strip() == 'Full-Service Providers') & (df['State'].str.strip().isin(['WA', 'WY']))]
wa_price = pd.to_numeric(sub[sub['State'].str.strip() == 'WA']['Total'].iloc[0])
wy_price = pd.to_numeric(sub[sub['State'].str.strip() == 'WY']['Total'].iloc[0])
result = 'yes' if wa_price > wy_price else 'no'
